hypothesis: A fixed one-hour compression-to-20-bar-breakout rule with volatility-scaled exits has positive incremental after-cost expectancy versus the same breakout rule without compression across a predeclared fixed set of liquid crypto perpetuals.
economic_mechanism: Low realized range can reflect temporary order-flow balance; a subsequent close beyond a recent range can reveal a new directional imbalance that persists as liquidity and leveraged positioning adjust.

source.point_in_time_reason: The instruments are fixed before outcome inspection and are not selected from a historical ranked universe.

primary_rule.breakout_definition: At completed bar t, LONG if close[t] is strictly above the highest high of bars t-20..t-1 and at least one of t-6..t-1 was compressed; SHORT is symmetric below the lowest low.
primary_rule.compression_definition: A completed bar j is compressed when ATR14[j]/close[j] is <= the 20th percentile of ATR14/close values from the preceding 168 completed bars j-168..j-1.
primary_rule.entry: next completed bar open after the signal; no same-bar entry
primary_rule.time_exit: next bar open after 24 full post-entry bars when neither stop nor target fired
primary_rule.gap_policy: stop gaps fill at the observed bar open if worse; target gaps receive only the target price
primary_rule.future_data_policy: No bar after signal close may enter compression, breakout, ATR, direction, or selection features; future bars are used only for entry/exit labels.
primary_rule.compression_percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted prior-window values at index q*(n-1)
primary_rule.regime_reporting: BULL when signal-bar close >= simple mean of closes t-167..t; otherwise BEAR. Reporting is point-in-time and used only for a catastrophic-instability guard.

baseline.rule: Identical direction, next-open entry, ATR stop/target, maximum hold, collision policy and costs, but no compression requirement.
baseline.purpose: Test whether the compression condition adds incremental economic value rather than merely rediscovering generic breakout behavior.

costs.interpretation: Composite conservative proxy for fees, bid/ask spread, slippage, funding/carry uncertainty and adverse selection because historical executable quotes/fills are unavailable.

chronology.split: 60% train / 20% validation / 20% untouched OOS by raw chronological bars

per_instrument_primary_required: primary challenger validation max-stress mean net bps >= baseline validation max-stress mean net bps
pooled_primary_required: validation first-half max-stress mean net bps > -20
validation second-half max-stress mean net bps > -20
validation max-stress mean net bps >= baseline validation max-stress mean net bps
for each validation BULL/BEAR regime with >= 8 trades, max-stress mean net bps > -60
sensitivity_required: q15 pooled train completed trades >= 40 and validation completed trades >= 12
q15 pooled train and validation max-stress mean net bps > 0
q25 pooled train completed trades >= 40 and validation completed trades >= 12
q25 pooled train and validation max-stress mean net bps > 0
sensitivities cannot rescue a failing primary rule

search_breadth.multiple_testing_policy: There is one eligible primary fingerprint. Three fixed instruments are mandatory replication cohorts, not winner alternatives. q15/q25 are predeclared non-selectable falsifiers and cannot replace or rescue the q20 primary.

selection_result_policy.on_data_integrity_fail: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; keep OOS locked and repair only the exact data deficiency without substituting instruments.
selection_result_policy.on_pre_oos_fail: REJECT_CURRENT_FINGERPRINT; persist negative evidence and pivot to the next materially distinct ranked hypothesis without tuning v1.
selection_result_policy.on_pre_oos_pass: FREEZE_EXACT_FINGERPRINT_AND_DATASET; request single-candidate deep validation; untouched OOS remains unopened until that central transition is canonical.

contract_fingerprint_definition: SHA-256 of canonical sorted compact JSON of this object with contract_sha256 and contract_fingerprint_definition omitted
